diagnosis: The Lambda handler updates an invoice to REISSUED status based solely on invoiceId from the URL path. It lacks an attribute condition or check verifying invoice.customerId matches claims.sub, allowing users to trigger billing recalculations and status resets on other clients' invoices.
exploit_request:
POST /invoices/inv_enterprise_99014/reissue HTTP/1.1
Host: api.billing.aws
Authorization: Bearer <customer_jwt>
